cases.name: no-clock
cases.why: no instant satisfies the witness policy, so expiry is not judged at all

cases.name: at-the-deadline
cases.why: expires == T has passed: the boundary two implementations disagree about

comment: the devices a node admits at evaluation time `t` (SPEC §5.3). `t` is the checkpoint's quorum time, never a wall clock, and t = 0 means there is no clock at all. A device is expired exactly when expires != 0 and expires <= t. `bundles` joins each active device to the §8.1 proof bundle that proves it, and gives both keys, because condition 3 means the replayed one and the fixture is the only thing that says so
